# Platform Overview — Layman Example

Plain-language version of the [notes](README.md#notes), for building intuition before diving into the real terminology.

**The big picture: AJO is like a smart control room for talking to customers.**

## 1. The 3 value drivers (the "engine" of the control room)

- **Real-time insights (RTCP)** — Imagine a filing cabinet that instantly updates itself every time a customer does *anything*: visits the website, calls support, makes a purchase in-store. Instead of a static paper file, it's alive: the moment new info comes in, the customer's file updates and they can be moved into or out of a marketing campaign right then and there.
- **Omnichannel orchestration** — Think of an event planner coordinating a wedding: invitations (email), reminders (SMS), day-of instructions (push notification) — all timed and worded to feel like one seamless experience, not five people randomly texting the guest. AJO's "Journey Canvas" is that planner's whiteboard, and "Message Designer" is where the actual invitation/message gets designed.
- **Intelligent decisioning** — Like a very experienced maître d' who's watched thousands of guests and knows "this person likes window seats and orders wine around 7pm" — so AJO's AI suggests the best offer and best send time for each person automatically, instead of a human guessing.

## 2. The 3 personas (who works in the control room)

- **Marketer** — decides *what* messages go out and *to whom* (like a marketing manager).
- **Data Architect/Engineer** — plumbs the pipes so customer data actually flows in correctly (like an IT/data person wiring up the building).
- **Admin** — manages who has keys to which rooms: permissions, environments/sandboxes, branding setup (like a building manager).

In a small team, one person might wear all three hats.

## 3. The homepage/UI

It's one shared app, and each persona just sees a different set of tools in the left-hand menu tailored to their job, instead of needing to log into separate systems.

## Takeaway

AJO = a single app where "know the customer live" + "coordinate every channel" + "let AI pick the best next move" come together, split across 3 job roles who each own a lane of the same tool.
